name: kbfix
description: Recover text typed with the wrong keyboard layout selected. Converts between a configured PAIR of languages, both ways, and never rewrites your prompt: a UserPromptSubmit hook says how the text reads and leaves what you typed alone. English, Hebrew, Russian and Spanish ship; adding a language is adding a folder.
